Commands
  model-info <model.obj|model.glb|model.fbx>
  scene-mesh-info <file.smo> <name-substring|*>

  build     <project.smolvlproj> <output.smo>
  roundtrip <source.smo> <project.smolvlproj> <output.smo>
  placements <project.smolvlproj>
  placement-transform <project.smolvlproj> <object-index>

  remove-branch-preserve <project.smolvlproj> <object-index> <output.smolvlproj>
  remove-placement <project.smolvlproj> <object-id> <output.smolvlproj>
  translate <project.smolvlproj> <object-index> <dx> <dy> <dz> <output.smolvlproj>
  set-placement-trs <project> <object-index> <px> <py> <pz> <rx-deg> <ry-deg> <rz-deg> <sx> <sy> <sz> <output.smolvlproj>

Main.Help.ControlsText:
CAMERA
RMB — orbit/free look. Shift+RMB — pan. Wheel — zoom or move forward/back.
In free perspective view, hold RMB and turn the wheel to adjust flight speed. WASD + Q/E — fly. Hold Shift to fly faster or Ctrl to fly slower. F — frame the selection.

SELECTION AND EDITING
LMB selects a whole object. Alt+LMB selects a single mesh part. Ctrl+LMB selects several objects.
Move/Rotate/Scale activate the gizmo. Hold Ctrl while dragging to snap.
Ctrl+C/V/D — copy, paste, duplicate a placement. Delete — remove it.
Ctrl+Z/Y — undo and redo. MOVE LINKED moves linked collision with the model.

CATALOG AND FILES
Double-click an asset card to show it. Drag a model into the scene or click Place.
Ctrl+S — save. Ctrl+Shift+S — save as. Ctrl+E — quick export.
Save a copy of the level before testing in game. A detailed log is written next to it.
